name: questionnaire
useFor: Use when an agent or a setup flow needs a few answers in a row (how to route calls, what to include in a summary). Pass the questions as items to Questionnaire, then render a QuestionnaireItem per question with a QuestionnaireTitle, a QuestionnaireDescription, QuestionnaireChoices of QuestionnaireChoice (add QuestionnaireInput for another answer) and a QuestionnaireError; end with QuestionnaireActions holding Previous, Skip, Next and Submit. Mark required questions; set multiple to allow several answers. onSubmit receives the native form event: read the answers with FormData.
constraints: More than one question on screen
A required question without its error message
A purple card fill for a chosen answer
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the radio and checks in Create Agent Identity and the Where does this agent run? picker

title: Questionnaire
description: Questions asked one at a time: white choice cards with the brand's radio or checkbox and a shortcut key, a typed answer, a progress count and Previous, Skip and Next pills.
